options.product: WorkOS - AuthKit Connect and Directory Sync
options.plan: Connect and Directory Sync entitlements not verified
options.configuration: Documentation research only; downstream OIDC plus application-integrated directory events

conditions: Confirm Connect entitlement, environment domain, application type and client configuration.
Upstream SSO accepting OIDC is not the same as Connect issuing OIDC tokens to an application.

evidence.summary: Connect OAuth applications use authorization code and can issue identity tokens with OIDC library integration. No Connect application or subscription was tested.

conditions: Choose a supported SCIM directory connector and confirm Directory Sync entitlement.
The application must consume directory changes and implement its own account lifecycle and access enforcement.
Directory Sync's read-only API does not write users back to the upstream directory.

evidence.summary: Directory Sync exposes directory users and groups through read-only APIs and change events. Its SCIM integration is a bridge, not proof of completed SaaS lifecycle enforcement.

conditions: Confirm the connector's group and membership behavior, environment and entitlement.
Map directory events into application membership and authorization; directory group data alone is not enforcement.

evidence.summary: Directory Sync describes updates to directories, users, groups and access rules. Application-side handling and the exact connector scope remain unverified.
